{{Quote|We no longer bother to deploy our designs on test environments and instead rely on simulations to predict the outcomes. Foolishness. Only the chaos of an unpredictable environment and its unique subjects can teach us anything.|Vel Jyc Boer|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Vel Jyc Boer''' was a master designer of an [[Unidentified Iokath species|unknown species]] from [[Iokath]] who designed [[SCORPIO]]. Vel Jyc Boer felt the species the designer belonged to was in decline and only felt joy reminiscing of the designer's creations from long ago. Resentful of both the species' current state and their own current life, Vel Jyc Boer recorded their private contemplation of unleashing their species designs' [[Iokath Civil War|on Iokath itself]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vel Jyc Boer is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in the codex entry 'History of Iokath: Entry 5.'<ref name="Codex" />
